findings.problem: NAMED_PROVIDER_MARKERS omits 6 of the 8 provider names mandated by the MC-21 verification contract (Copernicus, EMODnet, Open-Meteo, MeteoGalicia, Puertos del Estado, IHM). Only AEMET and OpenWeather are covered. An independently injected 'Copernicus no está contratado' into WEATHER content passes the validator 50/50 (MC21-04 still PASS), so the fail-closed provider-name gate would not catch a future insertion of these names. The e2e WEATHER test only asserts absence of 'meteoblue' and 'PredictWind' (neither is in the mandated list).
findings.requiredFix: Extend NAMED_PROVIDER_MARKERS to include at least Copernicus, EMODnet, Open-Meteo, MeteoGalicia, Puertos del Estado and IHM, and add corresponding unit (providerNameProblems) and e2e negative assertions for those names. Content itself is currently clean (independent grep = 0 matches for all 8 mandated names), so this is a defense-in-depth completeness gap, not a live content violation.
